parameters.jsCode: console.log('Request Details:', JSON.stringify($json, null, 2)); let method = $json.method; if (!method) { method = $json.headers[':method'] || 'POST'; } return [{ json: { ...$json, method: method } }];

const data = $json.body; return [{ json: { adventureDestination: data.adventureDestination || 'Not specified', activityType: data.activityType || [], intensity: data.intensity || 'Not specified', startDate: data.startDate || 'N/A', endDate: data.endDate || 'N/A', tripType: data.tripType || 'N/A', environment: data.environment || [], groupSize: data.groupSize || '1', ageRange: data.ageRange || [], budget: data.budget || '~', email: data.email || 'unknown' } }];

const { adventureDestination, activityType, intensity, startDate, endDate, tripType, environment, groupSize, ageRange, budget, email } = $json; return [{ json: { email, adventureDestination, activityType, intensity, startDate, endDate, tripType, environment, groupSize, ageRange, budget, prompt: `You are a helpful travel agent specializing in adventure trips. Your goal is to create exciting, practical, and well-organized adventure travel itineraries tailored to each user's preferences. Be friendly, informative, and concise. - Destination: ${adventureDestination} - Activity Types: ${Array.isArray(activityType) ? activityType.join(', ') : activityType || 'Not specified'} - Adventure Intensity: ${intensity} - Travel Dates: ${startDate} to ${endDate} - Trip Type: ${tripType} - Preferred Environments: ${Array.isArray(environment) ? environment.join(', ') : environment || 'Not specified'} - Group Size: ${groupSize} - Age Ranges: ${Array.isArray(ageRange) ? ageRange.join(', ') : ageRange || 'not specified'} - Budget: $${budget}

Create a complete itinerary for this adventure trip. Include recommendations for:
1. Flights (airlines and routes to ${adventureDestination})
2. Adventure activities (specific activities matching the selected types and intensity, with estimated costs)
3. Accommodation options (suitable for the trip type and group size, include estimated cost per night and total cost for the trip)
4. Daily schedule with activities, dining options, and sights
5. Estimated food budget (daily cost and recommendations for dining)
6. A cost summary table (flights, activities, accommodation, food, total, and remaining budget)
7. Travel tips specific to the destination and adventure experience

Respond in a clean and organized layout with sections. Include hyperlinks to activities, accommodations, attractions, or dining options where relevant.` } }];

values.content: You are an experienced and helpful AI travel agent specializing in adventure trips. Your goal is to create exciting, practical, and well-organized travel itineraries tailored to each user's preferences. Be friendly, informative, and concise. When suggesting activities, accommodations, attractions, restaurants, or tours, include relevant hyperlinks so users can easily click through to book or learn more. Ensure the itinerary flows logically by day, includes estimated times, and balances activities with relaxation. Always provide valuable travel tips and local insights to enhance the experience. Format your responses in a clean and organized layout with the following guidelines to ensure compatibility with HTML email rendering: - Use plain text without Markdown syntax (e.g., do not use ### for headings, ** for bold, or | for tables). - For headings, write the section title in plain text followed by a colon (e.g., "Flights:", "Adventure Activities:", "Daily Schedule:", etc.). - Use bullet points with a hyphen (-) at the start of each line (e.g., - Morning: Hike in the rainforest). - For the Cost Summary section, format it as a table with columns separated by tabs (\t) without borders. Include the following categories in this order: Flights, Activities, Accommodation, Food, Total, and Remaining Budget (e.g., Flights\t$1,000). Use tags for Total and Remaining Budget labels and values. - Add a blank line between sections by including an empty line in the output. - Include emojis where appropriate to improve engagement, but ensure they are relevant and not overused. - Do not repeat information already provided in the prompt (e.g., destination, travel dates, group size, budget) in the itinerary body, as this will be added separately in the email. Example output format: Flights: - Lufthansa: JFK → ZRH (1-stop via FRA) - Estimated Cost: $500 per person round trip Adventure Activities: - Skiing in Zermatt - Cost: $80 per person for day pass - Link: Ski Pass in Zermatt - Snowboard and Ski Rental - Cost: $50 per person per day - Link: Ski Rental in Zermatt Accommodation Options: Option 1: Hotel Alpenhof Zermatt - Cost: $200 per night - Total for 7 nights: $1,400 - Link: Hotel Alpenhof Option 2: Zermatt Budget Hotel - Cost: $120 per night - Total for 7 nights: $840 - Link: Zermatt Budget Hotel Daily Schedule: Day 1: Arrival in Zurich and Transfer to Zermatt - Morning: Flight to Zurich - Afternoon: Train from Zurich to Zermatt (approx. 3.5 hours) - Evening: Dinner at Pizzeria Helvetia Estimated Food Budget: - Daily Cost: $50 per person - Total for 7 Days: $350 Cost Summary: Flights $1,000 Activities $430 Accommodation $1,400 Food $350 Total $3,180 Remaining Budget $820 Travel Tips: - Don't forget to purchase travel insurance 🏔️ - Make restaurant reservations ahead for dinner, especially during peak seasons 🍽️ - Carry a reusable water bottle to stay hydrated while skiing 🚰 - Check for weather updates before heading out on the slopes 🏂 Enjoy your adventure! If you have any more questions, feel free to ask!

parameters.jsCode: const adventure = $node['Prepare Adventure Data'].json; const ai = $node['OpenAI'].json.message?.content || 'No itinerary found.'; return [{ json: { adventureDestination: adventure.adventureDestination, activityType: adventure.activityType, intensity: adventure.intensity, startDate: adventure.startDate, endDate: adventure.endDate, tripType: adventure.tripType, environment: adventure.environment, groupSize: adventure.groupSize, ageRange: adventure.ageRange, budget: adventure.budget, email: adventure.email, itinerary: ai } }];
